requirement: 3/3 seeds at TASK_HEALTH PASS and SYSTEM_HEALTH PASS, on the G0-V5 standard
result: 3/3, zero non-PASS panels across all seeds
what_this_establishes: the 4v4 arm is competent. It is playing CTF, not degenerating, so a later NO_REVERSAL could not be dismissed as an artefact of an incapable baseline.
what_this_does_NOT_establish: that allocation capacity expanded -- that is Stage 1
that any preference reversal exists -- that is Stage 2
anything about latents, routing, or strategic demand

comparison_to_the_2v2_control.note: descriptive only. These are BLUE training-telemetry commitments under different metric definitions from the Stage-1 red-side measures, and no criterion depends on them.
comparison_to_the_2v2_control.the_thing_being_firewalled: the 4v4 arm shows roughly 2.5x the offensive commitment while holding defensive commitment broadly comparable. That superficially resembles the simultaneous-commitment capacity C7 exists to test, and it is NOT evidence for the hypothesis. Stage 1 measures RED opponents' offence and contest on a frozen protocol against the 0.885 ceiling.

fail_fast_note: seeds were run one at a time. Stage 0 is a conjunction, so a single failure would have closed it without spending the remaining ~7 GPU-hours per seed. All three were needed and all three passed.

execution_history.first_launch_of_3300001: ABORTED at ~100k. TASK_HEALTH=ERROR with all metrics None, caused by the validation panel building a 2v2 env for a 4-agent policy. ERROR is an unmeasurable gate, not a failing policy, so fail-fast was deliberately NOT applied to it.
execution_history.fix: run_c7_stage0_4v4 rebinds run_g0_v2_evaluation.AGENTS as well as the training module's
execution_history.what_the_aborted_run_paid_for: the policy-head comparison in C7_SHAPE_PROVENANCE.json -- the 4v4 action head is [55, 256], identical to the 2v2 trained head, so per-agent policy sharing is unchanged and team size did not alter the policy parameterisation

stage_1_question: did the manipulation actually expand allocation capacity? Some opponent must achieve an offence+contest sum exceeding the maximum observed at 2v2 (0.885, OP7). If not, the treatment is inert, C7 stops, and Stage 2's block 9920000 remains unspent.
